correctness.rationale: Exact graph-geodesic face decomposition; homotopy pushout attaches contractible simplices along vertex-discrete subcomplexes, yielding a circle for every additional vertex per part; join of discrete complexes yields top spheres. Integral relative LES yields degree-one augmentation lattices for at least three parts and a two-vertex multigraph gives the bipartite cross-edge kernel. Join chains prove the signed top permutation lattice; maximal face census and shellability obstruction follow. The standalone verifier checked 112 cases and two finite-field boundary ranks; infinite proof is symbolic.
